title: Cauchy-Binet recursion bounds determinant-power squarefree coefficients sharply

statement.quantifiers: All integers d,r>=1, n=dr, arbitrary vectors v_i in C^d or R^d, including zero columns.
statement.assertion: 0<=[t_1...t_(dr)]det(sum_i t_i v_i v_i*)^r<=(r!)^d prod_i||v_i||². r copies of each orthonormal basis vector attain upper equality.
assumptions: Rank-one PSD coefficient matrices; exactly dr columns.
Ordered partitions of columns into r size-d blocks; nonnegative determinant-square weights.

inputs: d-dimensional vectors, integer power r and squarefree coefficient query.
outputs: Sharp norm-product upper bound and explicit equality fixture.
interface.precision: Exact finite algebraic inequality. Numerical enumeration is unnecessary to the stated induction.
costs: Direct coefficient enumeration has combinatorial cost; the bound alone is not a sampling/counting algorithm.
Known representation identities needed for entanglement applications remain separately imported; historical priority unknown.

proof_mechanism: Normalize nonzero columns; zero-column case gives zero both sides.
Induct with ((r-1)!)^d, sum weights=det(VV*), then eigenvalue AM-GM and Tr(VV*)=dr.
Balanced repeated basis factorizes Q and supplies (r!)^d equality; homogeneity restores norms.
obstructions: Restricted rectangular immanant application requires PSD Gram rank<=d.
The inequality does not settle arbitrary-rank permanental dominance or prove entropy additivity.

potential_uses.target: Other determinant-cluster overlap or rank-restricted immanant bounds
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Retain positive rank-one coefficients, the ordered-partition normalization and a legitimate low-rank representation. Identify prior mixed-discriminant/immanant results before a novelty claim.

review.source_reported: Source single-agent derivation and finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
